entries.intent: Of two concurrently acquired buffers, committing the one with the older base gives exactly that buffer's pixels, with damage widened to cover every pixel that changed. With `acquire-stall` holding thread 1's replay copy from front A halfway, thread 2 commits C and then acquires: it does not get A until the copy ends, and thread 1's buffer equals exactly the commit its returned base names. A stale buffer committed after more than eight intervening commits gets whole-window damage. Every step compares whole pixels to the formula and checks that the damage covers every changed pixel
